expected.evidence_contract: Exact root bytes and explicit target-framework union only. Accepted acquisition observations supply resolved closure and package inspection; caller-prevalidated reviews supply complete grant applicability to each entire dependency version. Hashes prove bindings, not those observations' truth or reviewer authority. No legal approval or overall readiness conclusion.

cases.rationale: Exact root bytes alone supply neither explicit assessment TFMs, a closure nor dependency license evidence.
